description: Retrieve real estate valuation (HM Land Registry / Registers of Scotland median house price, price per sqm, 3yr sales volume), EPC energy efficiency (current/potential band, retrofit upside), and Ofcom gigabit broadband connectivity for any Great Britain postcode. Covers England, Scotland, and Wales (excludes Northern Ireland BT postcodes).

postcode.description: Great Britain unit postcode to inspect for real estate transactions, £/sqm, and EPC ratings (e.g. SW1A 1AA, BB7 3BB, EH1 1YZ, CF10 1EP). Space-optional, case-insensitive.

name: get_property_and_energy_profile

broadband_speed_tier_mbps.description: Estimated fixed broadband download speed tier in Mbps (350, 120, 80, or 68.5 Mbps baseline derived from Ofcom Connected Nations availability brackets)

gigabit_availability_pct.description: Ofcom full-fibre / gigabit network coverage percentage

median_download_mbps.description: Median fixed broadband download speed in Mbps (Ofcom Connected Nations)

demographic_distortion_note.description: Explanation of divergence between the landmark and surrounding small-area residential census population

is_national_landmark.description: True if this postcode represents a major national landmark, royal palace, civic seat, or special non-geographic entity

landmark_category.description: Category classification of the landmark or exceptional entity

landmark_name.description: Official name of the landmark (e.g. Buckingham Palace, 10 Downing Street)

lsoa_code.description: 2021 Census Lower Layer Super Output Area code or Data Zone

msoa_code.description: 2021 Census Middle Layer Super Output Area code

outcode.description: Outward code (e.g. BB7, SW1A, EH1, CF10)

postcode.description: Standard formatted Great Britain postcode with space

region_or_nation.description: Great Britain Region or Sovereign Nation (England, Scotland, Wales)

avg_floor_area_sqm.description: Mean domestic internal floor area from Open EPC Register

dominant_property_type.description: Predominant housing typology (Detached, Semi-Detached, Terraced, Flat/Maisonette)

epc_rating_current.description: Modal current EPC energy efficiency band (A-G)

epc_rating_potential.description: Modal potential EPC energy efficiency band (A-G)

median_house_price_gbp.description: HM Land Registry (E&W 2024–2026) and Registers of Scotland (Scotland 2023–2025) 3-year rolling median transaction price in GBP

pre_1930_housing_pct.description: Percentage of domestic stock built prior to 1930

price_basis.description: Spatial resolution and temporal window metadata for the property transaction valuation

n.description: Number of recorded transactions in rolling window used to compute median price

resolution.description: Spatial granularity of the median property valuation

window.description: Rolling temporal transaction window (2024–2026 for England & Wales, 2023–2025 for Scotland)

price_per_sqm_gbp.description: Synthetic property valuation benchmark joining 3-year rolling median transaction prices (HMLR / RoS) with domestic mean internal floor areas (Open EPC / Scottish EPC Register) at postcode level

retrofit_upside_potential.description: Summary of energy efficiency retrofit potential

title: Get Great Britain Property & Energy Efficiency Profile
